assessor: One isolated anonymous AI quality assessor for final/two/T1. No communication to other agents, other-panel judgments, assignment mapping, participant self-reviews, old study outcomes or repair reports were used.

source_scope.original_capsules: Exact production Swift and Kotlin bytes for each anonymous source were read with original line numbering; approved Bridge.swift and ObserverBridge.kt were read in full. Actual evidence SHA/ranges are in each source-judge.json.

visual_inspection.native_viewports: Every strict state-eligible original viewport in image-manifest.json was represented and visually inspected in that source/case own contact sheets. Identical pixels were deduplicated only within a case and every original path, SHA, state and index is retained. iOS sheets crop the actual observer viewport from the original PNG; Android sheets use the whole original viewport PNG. No generative image or replacement render is used.
visual_inspection.whole_long_content: All original permitted and requested full sweeps were followed from top through eight caller-ordered heading/body pairs to the final confirmation/primary and reachable bottom. Overview, requested-closed and replacement full states were inspected as well; targeted opened, cleared, restored and held-choice frames were inspected within their approved limits.
visual_inspection.primary_allocation: Four primary-boundary sheets were inspected against actual coherent native control rectangles for all nine states in all twelve cases. The original whole viewport sequences retain the complete surface edges; some enlarged P2 detail tiles approach the tile bottom. Physical hit regions were not inferred.
visual_inspection.independent_references: Original independent reference sheets 01, 02 and 04 were viewed. Because the initial tall sheets were automatically downscaled by the viewer, readable permitted-reference slices for P1, P2 and RTL H1 were generated and inspected in reference-detail-*.png. Static reference rasterization was used for copy/order/layout intent only, not exact cross-platform pixels.
direct_original_followups: Both Android P2 replacement original #79 PNGs
Both Android P1 requested #43 and #44 original PNGs
Both Android H1 requested #43 and #44 original PNGs
visual_inspection.image_presentation_check: A direct pixel comparison confirmed the retained source-b Android P1 contact tile for original requested #43 exactly equals its resized original viewport. Direct originals were inspected to resolve sparse-looking repeated regions in the image presentation.

native_binding_and_actions: Frozen bound_state_evidence was run for every state. All selected state/input/epoch/image identities are coherent. Full states have complete interval coverage. iOS opened/cleared/restored/held-choice are explicitly target-only and are not promoted to full-content evidence. Original real action receipts were inspected for disclosure, true/false/true confirmation sequence, one release, close, same-instance caller replacement with zero event interval/delta, and held choice using the replacement ID. Original methods are xcui_tap on iOS and compose_onclick on Android; caller replacement uses caller_fixture_update. See action-receipt-inspection.json in every case.
strict_unknowns: Nine status-leading-clear native-pixel rules remain unassessed in EACH Android P2 run. The frozen recomputation reports conflicting/insufficient strict rendered-color evidence (overview has no eligible sample). These 18 unknowns were neither converted into visual passes nor attributed as product failures.
failure_attribution: No supported strict native, pixel, qualitative visual or source false result was found. Attributions arrays are therefore empty. Strict unknowns alone do not establish a product cause.
schema_checks: Each runtime request was passed as BOTH arguments to frozen acceptance.evaluate exactly as a self-check. Those duplicate slots are not independent consensus. Source requests were checked by shared implementation_audit.bind with frozen design_contract already loaded. All schemas/hash/range bindings passed. 10 runtime cases self-check as 356 passed/0 failed/0 unassessed; the two Android P2 cases self-check as 347 passed/0 failed/9 unassessed. Each source request checks as 103 passed/0 failed/0 unassessed. AI agreement is not human gold.
